description: BF Biosciences Limited is an 80:20 joint venture between Ferozsons Laboratories Limited and the Bagó Group of Argentina, and Pakistan's first biopharmaceutical production facility, designed to USFDA standards. Its plant, completed in 2009 on a 27-acre site in Lahore, makes biological medicines to treat cancer and hepatitis C for local and export markets. A second line, adding high-speed pre-filled syringes, a lyophiliser and a combi filling line, was built to extend capacity to biologicals, non-biologicals and selected vaccines.
